data.name: Mahantesh
data.gender_notes: Mahantesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Maha: great, Antesh: lord. The name Mahantesh signifies the great lord or the supreme deity. The name Mahantesh carries the meaning “Great Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mahantesh usually hope their child will grow to embody great lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of devotion and surrender to the divine.
data.etymology: Mahantesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Great Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahantesh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mahantesh is rooted in Indian culture and holds a deep sense of reverence and respect towards divine entities. In Hindu mythology, the use of the prefix 'Maha' indicates greatness and the suffix '-eshwara' or '-eshvara' signifies a lord or deity. Mahantesh is an honorific title used to address a revered or respected figure, often a spiritual leader or a god, reflecting the strong spiritual connection within Indian culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mahantesh carries profound spiritual significance as it implies the presence of a great divine being, representing the ultimate source of creation and sustenance. It serves as a reminder of the existence of a higher power and the interconnectedness of all things in the universe. The name also inspires devotion and reverence towards the deity or spiritual figure, fostering a sense of peace, love, and gratitude.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mahantesh: Great Lord of the Mind. Dedicated to the Supreme Self, mastering the mind's desires and attachments.
